## Project Specifications

### 1. Daily Spark
- Type: Productivity App
- Tech Stack: Python, Firebase, React, AI/ML, TypeScript
- Description: A habit-tracking application built with Python, Firebase Realtime Database, React, and TypeScript. Tracks habits and analyzes user patterns to generate daily routine suggestions.
- Live App: https://daily-spark-app-da74b.web.app
- Source Code: https://github.com/sahaya-savari/daily-spark

### 2. PrepMind AI
- Type: AI Education Platform
- Tech Stack: Python, OpenAI API, React, Tailwind CSS
- Description: An AI study companion using LLM integration pipelines to generate practice questions and concept summaries.
- Status: In Development
- Profile Link: https://github.com/sahaya-savari

### 3. Portfolio Website
- Type: Web Development
- Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Vite, Firebase Hosting
- Description: A modern portfolio website featuring glassmorphism design, hardware-accelerated animations, static HTML pre-rendering, and tailored security headers.
- Live Site: https://sahayasavari.me
- Source Code: https://github.com/sahaya-savari/portfolio

### 4. NeoBeat
- Type: Web Audio Application
- Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, Web Audio API, Canvas API, Framer Motion
- Description: An experimental web application for discovering independent artists, featuring a brutalist UI and audio visualizations using the Web Audio API.
- Status: Archived
- Source Code: https://github.com/sahaya-savari/neobeat
